nodes.text: New-onset unprovoked seizures with epileptogenic EEG abnormalities: high recurrence risk warrants antiseizure therapy

Screen for depression and suicide risk at each clinical follow-up visit using validated questionnaires
Emphasize driving restrictions and seizure safety precautions until seizures are fully controlled
